resource.name: SubtitleYC
resource.creator: BambooYC123
resource.category: Subtitles, transcription, dialogue cleanup, and automatic editing
resource.description: Extracts burned-in subtitles with OCR, supports frame-accurate review and exports SRT, ASS or text. Standalone subtitle preparation utility; not a Resolve plugin.
resource.platformNotes: Windows setup downloads FFmpeg and CPU OCR; NVIDIA GPU OCR is optional.

requirements.dependencies: FFmpeg and VideOCR/PaddleOCR installed by setup
requirements.installation: Windows setup requires internet access. CPU OCR is required and runs locally after installation. Optional GPU OCR requires a supported NVIDIA GTX 16 or RTX 20–50 card and driver 576.57 or newer.
